source.adph_health_departments_status: Soft HTTP 200 404 page at retrieve time; ADPH Well Water page links county health departments to /about/locations.html which also soft-404d. Use ACES county list + ADPH Well Water as working finders.
limitations: ADEM BacteriologicalLabs.pdf revised October 30, 2023; InStateChemicalLabs.pdf revised November 6, 2023 — older than the Oct 2025 out-of-state and PFAS PDFs. Transcription used the PDFs that returned HTTP 200 from ADEM waterforms and sites/default paths.

ADEM hub states lists contain both commercial laboratories and water-system laboratories. Municipal / utility / water-plant labs from the bacteriological and in-state chemical PDFs were omitted from the commercial table.
ADPH Bureau of Clinical Laboratories Prattville and Mobile Branch Laboratory appear on the bacteriological PDF but are documented in the verified private-well path — not as commercial rows.
Houston County Regional Water Lab (county.gov email) omitted from commercial table as a county regional water lab.
All out-of-state chemical labs (Oct 3, 2025 PDF) omitted from the main table — cite/link only. Certified PFAS Labs PDF (Oct 3, 2025) linked as optional note; all listed PFAS labs are out-of-state.
Commercial private-well acceptance unknown for every commercial row — call first. ADEM says consumers may use certified labs to test private wells.

ADPH BCL private-water instructions (Rev. 05-24) state BCL does not perform any chemical analysis of private well water; tests total coliform including E. coli; fee currently waived for each private water sample (confirm current policy).
ADPH /about/health-departments.html and /about/locations.html returned soft-404 pages at retrieve time despite HTTP 200; ACES county list used as working county finder.
Pace Analytical National Decatur address/phone differ between bacteriological and chemical PDFs — both shown. Southern Environmental Testing Florence street printed “Norhtington” on chemical PDF.
Prices intentionally omitted except noting BCL form says fee currently waived (confirm).

verified_paths.name: ADPH county health department / BCL private-well bacteriological testing
verified_paths.notes: ADPH Well Water: call your county health department and request that an environmentalist collect the sample (collection fee may apply), or collect yourself using bottles from county health department or Bureau of Clinical Laboratories. Results ~24 hours after receipt. BCL private-water instructions (Rev. 05-24): total coliform including E. coli only; BCL does NOT perform chemical analysis of private well water; samples Mon–Thu 7:30 am–4:00 pm; must be received within 30 hours; fee currently waived (confirm). Prattville Laboratory: 204 Legends Court, Prattville, AL 36066 / P.O. Box 1000, Prattville, AL 36067; (334) 290-3201 (instructions) / (334) 290-6130 (form header). Mobile Division Laboratory: 757 Museum Drive, Mobile, AL 36608; (251) 344-6049. Guidance phone on instructions: Bureau of Environmental Services / RSA Tower (334) 206-5373.

verified_paths.name: ACES / ADEM certified labs for chemical and more comprehensive testing
verified_paths.notes: ACES advises county health department for bacterial contamination; for nitrates/alkalinity and more comprehensive tests, contact an ADEM-certified drinking water lab and ask what they offer private well owners. ADEM hub: consumers may also consider a certified laboratory to test private wells.
